ebay:157673896203.description:
Alec Soth’s "Sleeping by the Mississippi" is widely regarded as one of the most influential photobooks of the 21st century. Originally published in 2004, this 2017 MACK edition is the definitive version, celebrated for restoring the book's original scale and sequence. It features 46 large-format color plates, including two "lost" images not found in the original Steidl printing.

This particular copy is hand-signed by Alec Soth on the title page, making it a cornerstone acquisition for any serious collector of modern American photography.

Condition & Specifications

  • Condition: Excellent / Near Fine (Gift-Quality).

  • Format: Hardcover, yellow cloth-bound boards.

  • Dimensions: Approx. 11" x 11.5" (28 x 30 cm).

  • Publisher: MACK, London (2017).

  • Internal State: Internal pages are crisp, bright, and untouched. The large-format color plates display exceptional tonal range and the signature "Mississippi" palette is vibrant and true.

  • Cover: The iconic yellow cloth boards are clean and vibrant. Corners are sharp and the binding is tight and square.

Collector’s Note

This MACK edition is highly prized by bibliophiles for its superior color fidelity compared to later reprints. Soth’s work—situated in the tradition of Walker Evans and Robert Frank—captures a poetic and raw "third coast" of America. A signed copy of this specific edition represents both a significant artistic document and a stable archival investment.

Archival Shipping & Handling

Given the weight and the susceptibility of the yellow cloth boards to shelf wear, this book will be handled with "white-glove" care:

  • Box-in-a-Box Method: To ensure the corners remain sharp, the book is wrapped in acid-free paper, bubble-wrapped, and shipped in a rigid, oversized box.

  • Professional Packaging: Shipped flat with reinforced edges to prevent any transit dings.

  • Tracking & Insurance: Fully insured domestic shipping with signature tracking is included.
